tei:div.tei:p: bcom ldan 'das kyi lung rim par bstan te/ bstan pa gtad pa ni/ ston pas 'od srung chen po la gtad/ de nas rim bzhin du/ kun dga' bo dang*/ shā na'i gos can/ nyer sbas/ dhī dhi ka btsun pa buddha nanti la/ buddha mi tra la/ des slob ma dge slong rtsib la/ des su na sha ta la/ des rta skad la/ des ma shi ba la/ des klu sgrub la/ sangs rgyas 'das nas lo bzhi brgya'i dus su/ bstan pa gtad cing*/ khong gi lta ba gtan la 'bebs pa ni/ shing rta chen po'i srol lam dang po gtod de/ de nas yang rim pa bzhin arya de ba/ rā hu la/ saddha nanti la/ dge slong dgra bcom la/ gha la sha la/ ku mā ra dza la/ sha ya ta la/ ba su bandhu la/ ma no ta la/ ha ga ni ka ya na sha la/ des dge slong seng ge la bstan pa gtad cing*/ 'di yan la thub pa chen pos rgyal tshab dang bcas pa/ bstan pa'i bdag po nyi shu rtsa lnga/ de rting sangs rgyas 'das nas lo stong la nye ba na 'phags pa thogs med byon te/ shing rta'i srol lam gnyis pa gtaud cing*/ de nas phyogs kyi glang pos shing rta'i srol lam gsum pa gtod pa lags/ de nas rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ grub chen brgyad cu/ ku su lu rnam gnyis/ mkhas grub rim par byon pa rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa lags so/ /sangs rgyas shākya thub pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i zhing khams kyi ming*/ stong gsum mi mjed 'jig rten zer la/ stong gsum gyi dbye ba ni/ ri rab gling bzhi/ gling phran nyi zla/ lcags ri khor yug tshang ba gcig nas bgrang ba'i cha stong la stong chung yang zer la/ stong spyi phud gcig go /de stong la stong gnyis pa bar ma'o/ /de stong la stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams zer ro/ /de rnams re re bgrangs na/ ri rab gling bzhi'i tshangs ris man chad bye ba phrag brgya stai/ dung phyur gcig go /mi mjed ces bya ba ni/ bzod pa'i ming ste/

pad dkar las nyon mongs pa dug gsum gyi mi phrogs shing bzod la/ snying rje pad dkar las/ ci phyir 'jig rten gyi khams de ni mi mjed ces bya zhe na/ sems can de dag 'dod chags la mi mjed pa dang*/ zhe sdang la mi mjed pa dang*/ gti mug la mi mjed pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba rnams la mi mjed pas de'i phyir 'jig rten gyi khams der mi mjed ces bya'o// de la sems bsran thub pas na/ mi mjed sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams zhes bya'o// stong gsum mi mjed kyi zhing 'di ni/ mnyam du chags par byed do/ /lar thub pa gangs can mtsho'i phyag mnyam bzhag tu mdzad pa'i steng/ lhung zad gyi nang na stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams cha nyi shu rtsa lnga brtsegs mar yod pas/ bar pa bcu gsum pa de mi mjaid 'jig rten gyi khams 'di yin par 'dod cing*/ yang lugs gcig la/ stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gyi khams cha lnga lnga dbus dang phyogs rigs bsgrigs pa/ lnga brtsegs su yod pa'i dkyil ma de thub pa'i zhing mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams 'di yin par 'dod pa yang yod do// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ rgyal rabs mang po'i legs bshad rnam grangs yid 'dzin nor bu'i phreng ba/bstan pa'i btad rabs kyi skor/ -PAGE 36--PAGE 37--PAGE 35-
